# STEM Nova Recognition

The following recognition items may be available through your local council.

**Patches.** Scouts only need to order one patch, no matter how many STEM Nova
Awards they earn in the corresponding BSA programs – Cub Scouts, Scouts BSA,
and Venturing and Sea Scouts. Each program patch is the same design with a
border color that corresponds to the appropriate BSA program. After earning
the first STEM Nova Award, Scouts are recognized with a Pi pin (see below) for
each STEM Nova Award earned that is then attached to the patch.

## SUPERNOVA AWARDS

The STEM Supernova Awards are designed to take Scouts on a deep dive in
various STEM topics. Each Supernova Award is named after a famous scientist or
inventor and has a medal associated with it that is presented to the Scout.

###### CUB SCOUT SUPERNOVA MEDALS

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Dr.-Louis-Alvarez-
Bronze-150x150.jpg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20150%20150%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

**FOR WOLF AND BEAR RANKS**

**Dr. Luis W. ALvarez  (Bronze)**

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Charles-Townes-
Bronze-150x150.jpg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20150%20150%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

**FOR WEBELOS AND ARROW OF LIGHT**

**Dr. Charles H. Townes  (Bronze)**

###### SCOUTS BSA SUPERNOVA MEDALS

Scouts BSA Supernovas are earned in the following order, Dr. Bernard Harris
(Bronze), Thomas Alva Edison (Silver), and Dr. Albert Einstein (Gold).

**Dr. Bernard Harris (Bronze)**

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Thomas-Edison-
Silver-150x150.jpg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20150%20150%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

**Thomas Alva Edison (Silver)**

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Dr.-Einstein-

**Dr. Albert Einstein (Gold)**

###### VENTURING AND SEA SCOUT SUPERNOVA MEDALS

Venturing and Sea Scout Supernovas are earned in the following order, Dr.
Sally Ride (Bronze), Wright Brothers (Silver), and Dr. Albert Einstein (Gold).

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Dr.-Sally-Ride-
Bronze-150x150.jpg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20150%20150%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

**Dr. Sally Ride (Bronze)**

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Wright-Brothers-
